definitions.gloss: to eat one's way around; to try food at various places
definitions.explanation: To visit multiple restaurants, food stalls, or eating establishments to sample their food, often as a leisure activity or culinary exploration.

definitions.gloss: to eat while walking; to snack on the go
definitions.explanation: To eat food while walking along a street, especially at tourist spots or food markets.

examples.japanese: ラーメンを{食|た}べ{歩|ある}く。
examples.english: To eat ramen at various places.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}は{町|まち}のカフェを{食|た}べ{歩|ある}くのが{趣味|しゅみ}だ。
examples.english: My hobby is visiting different cafes around town on my days off.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}の{名店|めいてん}を{食|た}べ{歩|ある}いて、お{気|き}に{入|い}りの{店|みせ}を{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I ate my way around the famous restaurants of Kyoto and found a favorite.

examples.japanese: {商店街|しょうてんがい}で{食|た}べ{歩|ある}きする。
examples.english: To eat while walking through the shopping street.

examples.japanese: {屋台|やたい}の{食|た}べ{歩|ある}きが{楽|たの}しい。
examples.english: Eating at the street stalls while walking around is fun.

examples.japanese: {浅草|あさくさ}では{仲見世通|なかみせどお}りで{食|た}べ{歩|ある}きを{楽|たの}しむ{観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In Asakusa, many tourists enjoy eating their way along Nakamise Street.

notes:
Compound verb of {食|た}べる (to eat) + {歩|ある}く (to walk). The noun form {食|た}べ{歩|ある}き is extremely common and popular in Japanese food culture.

USAGE:
The noun form {食|た}べ{歩|ある}き is used more frequently than the verb form and appears in travel guides, food blogs, and TV programs. Sense 1 ({食|た}べ{歩|ある}き as visiting multiple eateries) is a popular leisure activity in Japan, with dedicated TV shows, books, and online guides. Sense 2 (eating while walking) is common at tourist areas and festivals, though some traditional areas consider it poor manners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べ{歩|ある}きグルメ — street food, food to eat while walking
- {食|た}べ{歩|ある}きマップ — food tour map
- ラーメンの{食|た}べ{歩|ある}き — ramen restaurant hopping
- {食|た}べ{歩|ある}きスポット — food tour spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲|の}み{歩|ある}く — to drink one's way around, bar-hopping
- はしご — hopping between multiple bars/restaurants (informal)
- {食|た}べ{比|くら}べ — taste comparison, trying the same dish at different places
